items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1960-11-03
items.q: And in addition to Mr. Piquet, this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins doing the interview.

ctx.x: Was there any different plantations you had in mind?

No, I don't remember the details of that. It's not that important to worry about. But I just thought we might, I thought if you had some old material in the scrapbooks we might have come across something there but it wasn't in this book of course. Well I think we'll turn it off and rewind. I might add on here though that we made this tape over at your daughter's bar room at the corner of Robertson and Ursuline and the date is November the 3rd, 1960. And in addition to Mr. Piquet, this is Bill Russell and Ralph…
